name: geo-score
description: Can AI engines cite your site, and do they? A free 0-100 readiness score, plus citation checks with your own API keys.
long_description:
geo-score measures AI visibility at three levels.

- **score_site** (level 1) scores a URL 0-100 against an open rubric: can AI engines reach, parse, trust and cite it. Free, no key, reads public pages only.
- **ask** (level 2) asks one question to each AI engine you have a key for, through its search-enabled API, and reports who the answer cites.
- **run**, **list_runs**, **report** and **diff** (level 3) track a question set over time, with intervals and a paired significance test.
- **status** says what can run right now, without spending anything.

Every key is optional and stays in your keychain; each is sent only to its own provider. No telemetry. Standard library Python 3.8+, no dependencies.

tools.name: score_site
tools.description: Score a URL 0-100 for AI-search readiness: can AI engines reach, parse, trust and cite it. Free, no key.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask one question to each configured AI engine and report whether the brand is cited. One paid call per engine.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run the tracked question set and save it. Spends API credits; dry_run shows the plan first.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Saved runs with their headline citation rate.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Citation rate per engine with 95% intervals, share of voice and cited sources for a saved run.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two runs with a paired significance test; 'change' only when the adjusted p < 0.05.

tools.name: status
tools.description: What can run right now: config, engines with a key, questions and caps. Never shows a key.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional. Enables ask and run on ChatGPT (openai); sent only to that provider. Stored in the OS keychain.

perplexity_api_key.title: Perplexity API key
perplexity_api_key.description: Optional. Enables ask and run on Perplexity; sent only to that provider. Stored in the OS keychain.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Optional. Enables ask and run on Gemini (Google AI Studio); sent only to that provider. Stored in the OS keychain.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional. Enables ask and run on Claude (Anthropic); sent only to that provider. Stored in the OS keychain.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Optional. Enables ask and run on OpenRouter; sent only to that provider. Stored in the OS keychain.

watch_config.title: geo-score-watch.json
watch_config.description: Optional. The config that run, list_runs, report and diff read; create it with `uvx geo-score@1.8.0 watch init`. Runs are saved next to it.
